name: Permian Link Project (Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America)

values.PipelineName: Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America System

monitor_reason: length: no pipe length published (solicitation names 42-inch greenfield pipe from Pecos County TX toward Midcontinent Zone, options to Beckham County OK, but no mileage); sponsor and endpoints present, but the step is only a non-binding solicitation, not a permit filing or FID.
researcher_notes: Not an existing row. P0222 is the existing Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America System and P7832 is its Texas-Louisiana expansion. Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America LLC issued a non-binding solicitation of interest on May 12, 2026, closing June 11, 2026. It describes a new 42-inch greenfield pipeline plus compressor stations, 2.1 million Dth per day north and 0.5 million south, target in service as early as July 1, 2030. No length is stated in the notice or the FactSet page. The straight-line span is likely well over 25 km, but that is not a sourced length. Revisit when a FERC filing or an open season result gives mileage. If added later, use the expansion row shape with the parent PipelineName exactly as the roster spells it. Confidence medium. Only the operator notice was checked in full; the FactSet page is a secondary description.
